candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record describes facial asymmetry noted since birth, specifically the right lower lip deviating inward when smiling or crying, with otherwise symmetric facial movement. candidate_relations.scope_detail: Asymmetric Crying Face Syndrome is a common name for the condition described.
